import json, copy, subprocess, hashlib

base = json.load(open("sbom.spdx.json"))

def run(doc, name):
    json.dump(doc, open("/tmp/t.json", "w"))
    r = subprocess.run(["python3", "validate_sbom.py", "/tmp/t.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    fails = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("FAIL")]
    caught = "CAUGHT" if r.returncode == 1 else "MISSED"
    print(f"{caught}  {name}: {fails[:1]}")

def mutate(fn):
    d = copy.deepcopy(base); fn(d); return d

run(mutate(lambda d: d.pop("creationInfo")), "remove creationInfo")
run(mutate(lambda d: d["packages"][0].pop("verificationCode")), "remove verificationCode (filesAnalyzed=true)")
run(mutate(lambda d: d["files"][0].pop("checksums")), "remove file checksums")
run(mutate(lambda d: d["files"][0].__setitem__("checksums", [{"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": "deadbeef"}])), "bad checksum format")
# corrupt file on disk -> checksum mismatch
import shutil, os
shutil.copy("metadata.json", "/tmp/metadata.bak")
open("metadata.json", "a").write("x")
run(base, "file tampered on disk (checksum mismatch)")
shutil.copy("/tmp/metadata.bak", "metadata.json")
run(mutate(lambda d: d["relationships"][1].__setitem__("relatedSpdxElement", "SPDXRef-Nonexistent")), "dangling relationship ref")
run(mutate(lambda d: d["packages"][0].__setitem__("SPDXID", "SPDXRef-bad_id!")), "invalid SPDXID charset")
run(base, "unmodified document (should pass)")
EOF
